## Coverage, decreases, binders and source correspondence

Governing manuscript/parent: `docs/yulang-operational-type-safety-ja.tex:203–207,237,953–977`, including its opening source-owner correction notice. Research manuscript status does not confer language authority. Actual Lean owners remain frozen: `PaperExecutionSyntax.lean:38–542,617–716` and `PaperExecutionTypingSubstitution.lean`.

Every constructor is covered: Value's 20 constructors, Computation's 26, PatternPlan's 11, and the sole constructors of ConstructorBranch, GuardedBranch, ValueArm, OperationArm, HandlerPlan and MapperPlan. No constructor is omitted. Lists include tuple/sequence/payload arguments, switch branches, recursive bindings, handler arms, remaining operation arms and actual template arguments. Record payload projections and recursive binding projections use concrete normalization lemmas; `List.sizeOf_lt_of_mem` provides the actual membership bound, `simp +arith` unfolds pair sizes, and `omega` combines it with the original constructor size equation. Pattern records destruct the optional default, establishing its size bound in the `some` case. Guarded branches and operation arms destruct optional guards. All such cases remain in the common induction.

Value.typeAbstraction explicitly unfolds mapping and applies the Value IH at `depth + 1`. OperationArm uses its actual rigid binder count and `liftSubN_add` to apply Pattern/Computation IH at `depth + rigidBinders`. No binder was replaced by a constant. View/adapter metadata and all operation-instance type fields use actual type-substitution commutation. TemplateBody retains its executable computation body, with depth plus actual type arity; every formal/result type is mapped. Operations retain payload/response templates, nominal constructors their whole payload list, primitives their whole arguments/result, and DeclarationTable all four entry lists and unchanged native-list identity.

The actual source → raw mapper → declaration consumer path is represented by these definitions. No source-to-generated-constraint-to-propagation-to-native/Rust correspondence theorem was established. Scope and shared witnesses of the original A/B claims remain unchanged.
